answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, slashed on a failed audit, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. The thread of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. A dawn of per-task receipts records who did what, and the spiral of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
